subject: QEMU_CONTROL_REFERENCE

sut.environment: WSL2/KVM with stock QEMU 11.0.2 q35/qtest, one pcie-root-port and one virtio-net-pci endpoint with AER enabled

hypotheses: Endpoint Correctable status deposition, Endpoint reporting/mask gates, Root status deposition and Root notification eligibility are separate observable states.
Root Error Command.COR_EN controls notification eligibility after Root reception and does not suppress Root Correctable Status or Error Source deposition in the QEMU 11.0.2 reference model.

result.allTuples: The requested single Correctable Error Status bit and Device Status.CED were recorded.

result.interpretation: E=1 and M=0 are required for Root deposition; changing R alone does not change Root Status or Correctable Source deposition.

limitations: This is a QEMU control reference, not VMware behavior and not a Qman product implementation result.
The matrix proves virtual config-space status and routing semantics; it does not reproduce physical link errors, device-internal recovery or electrical behavior.
The Root COR_EN conclusion is notification eligibility derived from the public QEMU model; this run did not independently attribute an MSI, MSI-X or INTx trace to the Root Port.
No Qman host service, guest filter, clear/reset lifecycle, health policy, quarantine behavior or physical qualification is implemented or closed by this evidence.
